label: The game's own art as a LoRA of the player's (rmwstyle, trained with FluxGym from seven of the game's pictures; STYLE-RIMWORLD.md)
style: rmwstyle, a comic illustration of a character for a sci-fi colony game: confident black ink outlines, heavier along the silhouette and finer inside, fine ink lines on the face for the eye sockets, cheekbones, laugh lines and stubble; clean cel shading in two or three tones with hard edges and a soft gradient inside the shadows; saturated colours on the clothing, warm skin with pink and orange shading, crisp white highlights on metal; a semi-realistic, angular face with defined brows, a clear nose line and small, sharply drawn eyes; a characterful expression; a cool rim light along the edges.
frame: A medium close-up, cut off by the bottom edge of the picture at the belt: only the head, shoulders, chest and arms are in the picture, large and close, the head near the top and about a third of the picture's height. One person alone, bare-headed with the hair in full view. Behind them one flat, even, dark blue-grey colour fills the whole picture from edge to edge.
style_end: In the same comic style throughout.
